speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me identify the cause, please tell me how long you have been feeling this way and if your symptoms have been constant or come and go.

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome / Myalgic Encephalomyelitis.

Since your symptoms worsen with exertion and are accompanied by recent infections, I need to check for anemia and thyroid dysfunction. REQUEST TEST: CBC, TSH. REQUEST TEST: Ferritin. REQUEST TEST: Vitamin D, B12.
